name: common_fa_target_v1
purpose: Pick event onset thresholds for M0 and ENS with one shared false-alarm target, so the Real comparison does not credit ENS for threshold tuning.
target: train held-out independent-normal final false events per valid-exposure hour <= 20
rule: for each model separately: smallest grid onset meeting the target. Other event parameters fixed (clear 0.4, k_on 3, k_off 3, min_event 0.5 s, merge 0.5 s).
data: events_per_case.csv and m0_sweep_supplement results from ens_event_threshold_v1 (train held-out rows only); val not used for selection
outputs: chosen onset per model; these, plus M0 at the deployment default 0.60, are the three arms for Real
forbidden: using val, internal test or Real for selection
changing target or grid after seeing selection
